Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Gay Week in Review, with Andy Humm, Darrell Yates Rist, Joyce Hunter, and Jim Levin, sponsored by the Human Rights Campaign Fund 2. Short news stories 3. Discussion of Catholic Archdiocese's banning of Catholic gay rights groups from churches COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 4. One year anniversary of the passing of New York City's gay right bill, with clips from GCN's coverage of the event, and discussion of the progress of gay rights since the bill COMMERCIAL: SF AIDS Foundation 5. Andy Humm on the growing participation of the gay community in activism 6. News Watch, Vatican newspaper criticizes condom use as a method of stopping spread of AIDS, advocating the stopping of gay sex 7. Seattle Times rejects an ad from Parents and Friends of Lesbians and Gays, due to the use of the word "gay" 8. Vermont, gay rights bill introduced in state legislature 9. Delta Airlines avoids national gay boycott after Delta agrees to meet demands of gay group, including non-discrimination of passengers with AIDS 10. Sports Report, with clips from the Dr. Ruth show 11. Lavender Health, interview with Felicia Schady, public health educator with the Hepatitis B Prevention Unit at the NYC Health Department 12. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. This Week in Gay History, with Jeff Bixby COMMERCIAL: Night of a Thousand Gowns charity drag ball s 2. Media Watch with Brandon Judell, interview with Helen [Schumaker], actress in the one-woman show, "Mona Rogers in Person," with clips COMMERCIAL: Zamir Furs 3. Show Bits with George Trahanis, review of Barbara Gelb's two-act, one-character play "My Gene" COMMERCIAL: "Manscape" gay magazine 4. Second part of the interview series on the operating methods of GMHC, with playwright Larry Kramer, and a response by the executive director of GMHC, Richard Dunne, tape cuts off
